doc: The refusal codes omx-panel emits, by the code word a refusal carries, each with its source sentence in English and the placeholders it may use (omx-contract's codes shape; translations are not here). Each language's sentences are in catalogs/<lang>.json, keyed by the code. The surfaces read both; no module repeats a sentence. A code is never reworded.

text.en: The override for {plugin} is invalid at {field}; fix skin.json and reload the skin.
The {field} entry {entry} for {plugin} was dropped ({reason}); the rest of the override still applies.
This skin declares API {declared}, which this console does not support (it serves {supported}); the skin is not loaded.
The skin's view failed: {message}. Reload it, or remove the skin if it keeps failing.
The view {file} uses the disallowed word {word}; remove it and reload the skin.
No MOD GUI to import was found in {file} ({detail}); nothing was written.
The bundle's {file} does not read as valid TTL ({detail}); fix it and import again.
{file} states no licence ({detail}); add one to its bundle before its MOD GUI can be imported.
The licence in {file} is not one this importer maps to an SPDX id ({detail}); add the mapping or change the licence.
The licence in {file} is outside the allowed list ({detail}); the MOD GUI is not imported.
{file} carries an unknown property ({detail}); remove it or correct it before importing.
{file} names a port that is not one of the plugin's own ports ({detail}); fix the symbol and import again.
{file} names an image that is not in the bundle's resources ({detail}); add the file or fix the reference.
{file} names a path that resolves outside the bundle ({detail}); nothing is imported from outside the bundle.
{file} already exists ({detail}); remove it first to import over it.
The MOD GUI script for {plugin} is dropped: its licence {licence} is missing or not allowed.
{plugin} has no control a panel can show, so it gets no panel ({message}).
{plugin}'s controls do not carry what that panel family needs ({message}); choose another family or none.
The panel declared for {plugin} cannot be laid out ({message}); fix its panel declaration.
The {layers} override layers for {plugin} were not applied: this host cannot read overrides.
The override layer {layer} ({name}) for {plugin} was refused: {message}. The layers below it still apply.
In override layer {layer} ({name}) for {plugin}, the entry for {control} was dropped: {message}.
The role {entry} on {symbol} of {plugin} is not shown ({reason}); the control stays on its page.
The skin's {field} entry {entry} for {plugin} was dropped ({reason}); the rest of the skin still applies.
A bar group of {plugin} has too few controls to draw as bars ({message}); they are drawn as knobs.
A bar group of {plugin} holds a control that cannot be a bar ({message}); fix the group in the panel declaration.
The controls of a bar group of {plugin} differ in range, step, unit or scale ({message}); bars must share them.
The labels of a bar group of {plugin} do not form one series ({message}); rename them or split the group.
A bar group of {plugin} names a control the plugin does not have ({message}); fix the symbol.
The Easy list of {plugin} was refused ({message}); the Easy page takes the rule instead.
